artworks.title: Three Shoshonee Warriors Armed for War
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing in a natural setting. The person on the left is pulling back an arrow in a bow, positioned to aim. They have a short hairstyle with feathers in their hair and wear a light blue loincloth with a sash and bracelets. The central figure is standing with legs apart, holding a spear upright and looking to their left. They have medium-length hair with feathers, necklaces, and wear a reddish-brown loincloth. The figure on the right stands relaxed, looking toward the central figure, and holds what appears to be a whip or rope. This person also has feathers in their hair, necklaces, and wears a reddish-brown loincloth. In the background, trees and plants are visible, painted in soft earth tones. The scene is framed within an oval border, set against a greenish-gray rectangular background.

artworks.title: Two Unidentified North American Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing upright on a grassy landscape. The person on the left has reddish hair styled in a mohawk, facial markings, a necklace and earrings, a light-colored cloak, and fringed pants. They hold an axe with a decorative handle. The person on the right has dark hair with feathers, facial markings, a large necklace, a detailed garment, and they hold a staff. The background features a clear sky with scattered clouds.

artworks.title: Pawnee Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts six people, all facing the viewer. On the left, a woman sits on the ground. A naked child is partially visible behind her on the left, and in front of her she holds a younger child in a decorated carrier with a square handle. On the right are three men, one sitting and the other two standing. The seated man is in the center of the painting, and he holds a bow and two arrows. The next man on the right holds an axe or similar weapon, and the third man on the right also holds a bow and two arrows. All of the people have light brown skin, and the woman and children have black hair. The men have no visible hair, but instead appear to wear headdresses of long, thin red fibers or feathers that radiate outward from the backs of their heads. The seated man also has long horizontal feathers or fibers extending on either side of his head. The men and woman are all adorned with jewelry, including layers of colorful necklaces, silver bracelets, and several earrings in each ear. The woman wears a long-sleeved tan dress, while the men have fur-lined tan garments draped around their torsos and tan pants with colorful beads and fringe. Their garments are painted with scenes of people on horseback or colorful geometric patterns. The men also have tattoos on their arms and torsos. The seated man has red handprints on his upper arms, and the dark outlines of a bull's head on his chest and face. He has a hooped ring in his nose. The background shows a blue sky and grassy ground. The painting is framed in a gray oval border with tan paper beyond it and a green outer frame.

artworks.title: A Pawnee Chief with Two Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing in full-length. The person on the left is holding a staff and wearing a feathered headdress and a robe with intricate designs. The central figure wears a robe fastened with a fur shawl, has a red mohawk hairstyle and holds a staff. The person on the right stands with a shield and a cylindrical object on their back. They all stand on a grassy patch with a light background, framed by a narrow pale green border.

artworks.title: Facsimile of a Pawnee Doctor's Robe with Fantastic Professional Designs
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of traditional indigenous imagery on a stretched hide. The artwork depicts stylized figures and scenes, including figures in traditional attire, adorned horses, motifs like a bear and geometric designs. The hide's edges are curling and uneven, indicating its natural origin. This style is reminiscent of indigenous ledger art, which historically used materials like hides for visual storytelling. The background is neutral, enhancing the contrast and detail of the painted scenes on the hide.

artworks.title: Facsimile of a Pawnee Doctor's Robe
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of scenes involving horses and buffalo on a leather-like backdrop. The painting appears to be executed on a surface resembling animal hide, framed within a border. The central area contains intricate drawings of mounted warriors and animals. There are figures riding horses, adorned with decorations, and scenes that suggest a narrative element. Below, there are animals such as wolves and a buffalo near a plant or bush. The painting's style is reminiscent of traditional Native American art, focusing on the relationship between humans, animals, and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Pawnee Indians Approaching Buffalo
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image is an oval frame with a separation between the painting and the solid color around it. The point of view is level, showing a natural landscape with a low horizon where grassy plains meet a treeline. In the scene, there are distant buffalo grazing to the left, two resting buffalo in the grass, and a figure partially obscured by foliage to the right. The color palette includes earthy tones, greens, and browns, with a gradient sky from yellow to blue. The brushstrokes are smooth and blended, creating a serene effect. The background transitions from greenery to a fading sky.

artworks.title: Encampment of Pawnee Indians at Sunset
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts a landscape with a group of people around a campfire, tipis on a hill, and grazing animals. The sky shows a blend of vibrant colors suggesting a setting or rising sun. The color palette includes earth tones and warm sky hues creating a peaceful rural setting.

artworks.title: Catching Wild Horses - Pawnee
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a wide expanse of land with a horizon featuring rolling hills or small mountains and sparse trees. In the foreground, a person in traditional indigenous attire is pulling on a rope tethered to a resisting horse. Several horses gallop energetically in the distance, while another horse stands alone to the right. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing textures, and the color palette consists of earthy tones. The sky is light blue with occasional white clouds.

artworks.title: A Pawnee Warrior Sacrificing His Favorite Horse
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a warrior and a horse. The image shows a warrior with traditional attire engaged with a rearing horse. The warrior is holding a spear and shield. The horse has detailed muscular features and an ornate saddle blanket. The background is minimal to highlight the interaction. The composition emphasizes movement and traditional cultural elements. This is in style of Karl Bodmer.

artworks.title: Osage Chief with Two Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three Native American individuals standing outdoors. Their full bodies are captured in a standing position. The person on the left is dressed in a fringed and beaded robe and is holding a long spear decorated with feathers. This individual has a distinct headpiece with feathers pointing upwards and is depicted with a quiver bag over their shoulder. The central figure wears a long, elaborately beaded tunic, a bold necklace, and holds an axe. They display a headpiece similar to the left figure, with strong cheekbones and an engaged expression. The person on the right wears a red shirt with intricate design and fringed pants, holding another axe. This individual also wears a feathered headpiece, necklaces, and other decorative elements. All three individuals are set against a pale, open background of sky and ground, with faint blue and green tones suggesting a grassy plain on a softly clouded day. The scene is framed in an oval shape, with a parchment border surrounding it.

artworks.title: Osage Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three men, a woman, and a baby sit or stand facing us in a row in front of a landscape within an oval-shaped painted frame in this horizontal painting. The Osage people have medium-brown skin, and the woman and baby have black hair. To our left, the woman sits on a tree stump and holds the nude child in her lap. Her long hair is loose, and she wears turquoise-colored earrings. Her floral-patterned wrap exposes one breast and comes down to her ankles. She wears tan-colored shoes, perhaps moccasins. The baby reaches for and grabs the woman’s necklaces. To our right, the man closest to the woman sits with his legs crossed, and the other two men stand. All three are bald with feathered headdresses, thick collars and necklaces, earrings, and red shapes and lines painted on their heads and bare chests and arms. They wear tan-colored, slightly baggy pants and knee-high moccasins. The seated man has three silver cuff bracelets and a wrap around his lap. An instrument he cradles in one elbow is long and narrow, and it widens slightly as it reaches a head that angles back from the body. It appears to be made of wood and the top surface painted red. One of the standing men holds a spear and the other bow and arrows. The landscape is faintly painted behind them. The pale green grass and trees meet the watery blue and very pale peach-colored sky about halfway up the composition. The scene is enclosed in a gray oval frame on a shell-pink card mounted on paperboard. A label with the number 52 is affixed at the top center of the board.

artworks.title: Facsimile of an Omaha Robe
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a Native American ledger-style artwork featuring various symbols and a buffalo. The painting is created on a background resembling tanned animal hide, bordered in a soft greenish-gray. Within this frame, the central portion is filled with numerous rows of small, horizontal red lines across the upper half. Below these lines are symbols and geometric patterns, including rows of triangular motifs and concentric circles. On the lower half, there are detailed depictions of two ornate tipi structures with long poles extending from their apexes, adorned in bright orange and red designs. Between and behind the tipis, there is a large buffalo.

artworks.title: An Osage Indian Pursuing a Camanchee
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting shows two figures riding on horseback from left to right across an open landscape. The composition features a horizon dividing grassy plains from hills in the background. The brushstrokes are detailed, portraying a sense of motion in the figures. The color palette includes warm earth tones for the figures, horses, and nearby surroundings, contrasted with softer greens and yellows in the landscape. The sky is depicted in a gentle blue with streaks of cloud.

artworks.title: Mandan War Chief with His Favorite Wife
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image features three individuals in traditional attire. In the center, a man wears a ceremonial headdress and a decorated tunic while holding a tall spear. To his right, a woman holds a large piece of hide, and to the left, a younger individual is crouching, adjusting his gear. The background has subtle blues and earth tones.

artworks.title: Three Mandan Warriors Armed for War
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals standing outdoors on a grassy area. The person on the left holds a spear and a shield. The middle person holds a shield in the left hand and a bow in the right, with an arrow ready to be fired. The person on the right is aiming a bow and arrow. All three individuals have long dark hair, feathers, prominent cheekbones, and eyes. The person on the left has painted markings on their face. They wear traditional attire with fringed garments, leggings, and moccasins, and hold circular shields with patterns and tassels. The background shows an overcast sky with hints of clouds. The scene is framed by a border with a green outer edge.

artworks.title: Four Mandan Warriors, a Girl, and a Boy
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts five individuals positioned together in an outdoor setting. Three adults are standing, with the fourth adult seated on the ground. The child is to the left, facing the group with a bow and arrows in hand. The individuals all have long hair, and the adults' hair is adorned with feathers. The adults wear traditional clothing; one of the standing adults is dressed in a decorative tunic with fringe and holds a shield with painted designs, while another is draped in a fur cape. The seated person is dressed in fringed pants and also has body paint on their arms. The setting shows a grassy landscape with a blue sky.

artworks.title: Mandan Civil Chief, His Wife, and Child
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows two adults and an infant. The adult on the right is standing in a frontal pose, wearing an elaborate feathered headdress. Their hair is long, straight, and dark, cascading down their shoulders. They are dressed in a decorative outfit with fringes extending to the ground, and are holding a long implement adorned with feathers in their left hand. The adult on the left is standing and appears to be facing slightly to the right, with their hair also long, straight, and dark. They are wrapped in a patterned blanket and holding a small infant in their arms. The infant is mostly wrapped and has a visible, small face with features that are not detailed. The background features a grassy area with a domed structure with an entrance, suggesting a plains setting, and the sky is slightly cloudy. The entire scene is encased in a softly shaded oval frame within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: An Aged Minatarree Chief and His Family
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals seated or reclining on the ground. On the left, an older man is seated, leaning back slightly, with patterned facial markings and long dark hair adorned with feathers. He wears a fur-trimmed shawl over his shoulders, elaborate leg coverings decorated with quillwork, and holds a long pipe with feathers attached. In the center, a younger man sits with a child on his lap; his hair is also long and decorated with feathers, and he has necklaces around his neck. To the right, a woman reclines, propped on one arm, with long hair and wearing a simple garment with necklaces. The background consists of a painted cloudy sky in pastel hues, suggesting an outdoor setting with sandy terrain, while a shield and spear decorated with feathers and fur stand in the ground behind them.

artworks.title: Three Minatarree Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body figures standing together. On the left is a female figure holding a feather, in a decorated dress. In the center is a male figure with long, ornamented hair and a beaded robe, holding a fur piece and shield. On the right is a male warrior in a dynamic stance, holding a bow. The background displays a soft, pastel sky with hints of blue and yellow.

artworks.title: Riccarree Chief and His Wife
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows two figures depicted from head to toe standing side by side. On the left is a man with long hair adorned with a feathered headdress. He has a mustache and a stern facial expression, and he is wearing elaborate traditional clothing decorated with colorful beadwork and fringes. The man is holding a pipe and a large ceremonial shield, which is also decorated with feathers. Next to him is a woman with long dark hair, wearing a dress with beaded detailing and fringes at the hem. Her hands are clasped together in front of her. She wears several strands of necklaces. In the background are several dome-shaped structures, likely traditional dwellings, with faint figures or bundles in front of them. The sky is light blue with some clouds, and the ground is grassy featuring light, earthy tones.

artworks.title: Mandan Village - A Distant View
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a wide river, viewed from a slightly elevated position on a riverbank. The horizon is positioned about one-third from the top, where the river meets the land in the distance. On the horizon, a faint outline of a bridge or structure is visible across the river. Closer to us, several people are engaging in activities like fishing and sitting among grassy patches on the riverbank, which has a sharp, eroded edge. The painting style uses smooth brushstrokes to capture the scene with detailed clouds and the flowing river. The color palette consists mainly of muted greens and earth tones for the landscape, and delicate blues with white and gray clouds in the sky, creating a calm and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Catlin Feasted by the Mandan Chief
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of six people seated inside a conical tent. One person, wearing a feathered headdress and traditional attire, sits at the center. Other individuals are seated around them, dressed modestly. There is a fire with a cooking pot, wooden posts supporting the tent, animal skins on the ground, and more people seated against the tent wall. Light filters in from an opening in the roof.

artworks.title: Green Corn Dance - Minatarrees
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of individuals engaged in a ceremonial dance. The artwork depicts several figures in traditional attire, arranged in a circle, performing a rhythmic dance. They are standing around a central structure formed by long, thin poles. The figures are depicted with detailed attire, adorned with feathered headdresses, and their bodies are elaborately painted with patterns. The sky is softly rendered with shades of blue. This is in the style of George Catlin.
